source_clause: 11.4 Sharing with Affiliates, Business Partners and Third-Party Processors
source_quote: LeapSwitch may disclose Personal Data to its affiliates, group companies, subcontractors, and service providers strictly for the purpose of delivering, customizing, or improving the Services. Any such sharing shall be subject to confidentiality obligations and data protection safeguards that are no less stringent than those imposed under Applicable Law. The Customer is deemed to have consented to such disclosures by availing the Services. LeapSwitch may also share Personal Data with its business partners to perform data analysis, service optimization, or customer communications, provided such partners follow equivalent standards of data protection.
